name: plugin-profiles
description: Switch which installed plugins are on with named profiles: one YAML file per profile, shipped, per user and per repository, each extending the one below. A command-line tool previews every change, checks the required prerequisites of each plugin it switches on, writes only the plugin and hidden-skill entries of a folder's local settings, user settings or a one-session settings file, and clear puts the file back as it was.

remember_folder_profile.title: Remember each folder's profile
remember_folder_profile.description: When on, a profile applied to a folder holds for every later session there. When off, every session starts from the initial profile: a folder apply is refused, and the session-start notice names a folder profile left from before as not in force. Read from managed settings first, then user settings.
